annotation.bound_parties_text: The draft guidance gives non-binding recommendations to those preparing premarket submissions for robotically-assisted surgical devices, and it imposes no obligations on any party.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The recommendations reflect FDA’s current thinking for these devices and are intended to promote consistency and facilitate efficient review of RASD submissions.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This draft guidance document provides recommendations on non-clinical testing, clinical data, and labeling to support premarket submissions for certain robotically-assisted surgical devices (RASDs).
